messages:
alex: Quick heads up — planning to launch the new OSS reference app (edge-serve-refapp) next Wed. Need a short launch post, a benchmark narrative that resonates with infra teams, a 30-min community webinar, and clear inbound lead routing (docs + demo signups). :rocket:

maya: SGTM. Can we draft two headlines: one technical (bench-focused) and one product/CTA? I can take the social copy + email blast.

jordan: Draft headlines — 1) 'Edge-Serve RefApp: 4x throughput at 1/3 the cost for short-context inference' 2) 'Ship production LLM apps at the edge — try the refapp and demo today'. Quick social copy below.

jordan: ```Social post draft:
Meet Edge-Serve RefApp — a minimal, production-minded reference app for edge inference. Includes deployment templates, perf benchmarks, and a quickstart demo. Sign up for the webinar: https://rwd.co/refapp-webinar :eyes: #opensource #inference```

sam: Webinar notes — 30 mins: 10m demo, 10m benchmark walkthrough, 5m integration patterns, 5m Q&A. Need a host, a bench owner to present numbers, and one eng for troubleshooting live demo. I can host if someone else does the bench.

lee: For benchmarks, let's highlight: median p99 latency on A100 (fp16) for 512 tokens, steady-state throughput with batching, and cost per token relative to hosted. Proposed snippet: "p99=48ms, throughput=240 tok/s, cost ≈ $0.0009/token (batching x4)" — need bench owner to confirm.

alex: @lee please own bench numbers. @maya take the social + email. @sam host the webinar. @jordan please prepare the short blog/launch post draft. I'll handle the release notes + press list.

maya: Timeline? We need: final blog draft by Mon EOD, social + email by Tue morning, webinar registration page live Tue afternoon, demo rehearsal Tue evening.

alex: Yep timeline confirmed. I'll book Wed slot and draft the registration form.

ops-bot: Reminder: marketing-publish workflow created — see PR #412 for scheduled publish pipeline.

lee: Quick request on routing — can we map demo signups to the growth CRM tag "refapp-edge-2026" and route engineering leads to eng-sales alias? Proposed mapping: demo signups -> demo-flow (growth), bench inquiries -> eng-sales, press -> comms-team.

sam: That routing mapping works for me. @alex please confirm with growth infra.

alex: Confirmed. I'll open the routing ticket and include required UTM params + hidden form field for "bench_interest".

jordan: Blog outline (short): 1) Why this refapp (pain + audience), 2) What it includes (templates + infra), 3) Benchmarks + methodology, 4) How to run it, 5) Webinar CTA + repo link. I'll post a draft in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/REFAPP_LAUNCH_DRAFT

maya: Small ask — can we include one short customer quote (partner early access) in the top fold? Even a one-liner about speed/cost would help clickthroughs.

lee: I can pull a quote from the partner POC, will get it by Mon AM.

alex: Nice. Risks: live demo flakiness and benchmark regression questions. Plan: rehearse with failover (pre-recorded demo clip) and include an appendix in the blog with raw bench scripts + seed data.

sam: Agreed. Schedule rehearsal Tue 5pm PT. I'll prep the pre-recorded fallback.

maya: I'll prepare two email subject lines to A/B test: 1) 'New: Edge-Serve RefApp + live demo' 2) 'Benchmark: 4x throughput for edge inference — try the refapp'

alex: Great. Next steps summarized: jordan blog draft by Mon EOD, maya social + email Tue AM, lee bench numbers + quote Mon AM, sam host + rehearse Tue 5pm, alex opens routing ticket and PR #412 links publish. We'll reconvene Mon 10am for a quick sync. :white_check_mark:
